job.name: ig40_cover
job.person_note: The SAME man as in the attached photo: same face, short dark hair, light stubble, burgundy knitted polo; do not change his face shape.
job.style: A finished, minimal, eye-catching vertical Instagram Reels COVER, cinematic dark studio photo with bold typography. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED. No logos, no watermarks, no UI elements.
job.style_qa: обложка: тот же мужчина в бордовом поло в тёмной студии; надписи «НЕ ПРОСИ ДЕНЕГ» и «ПРОСИ ЭТИ 5 ВЕЩЕЙ» без ошибок, других слов и логотипов нет
job.meaning: обложка Reels «Не проси денег — проси эти 5 вещей»
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cover. The man from the reference sits in a black leather armchair in a dark studio with a deep blue glow behind him, looking into the camera with a serious, confident expression, one hand raised showing five spread fingers; he fills the LOWER 58% of the frame, face fully visible and NOT covered by text. The UPPER part is dark navy-black background. In the upper part, between 15% and 40% of the image height: huge bold white condensed uppercase title «НЕ ПРОСИ ДЕНЕГ» in two lines, and under it a large bright yellow uppercase line «ПРОСИ ЭТИ 5 ВЕЩЕЙ». No other text.
